title: Analysis that Supported Development of SecureMyBike Project in Admiralty that was Eventually Discontinued
what_it_is: Analysis that Supported Development of SecureMyBike Project in Admiralty that was Eventually Discontinued

sections.label: SecureMyBike studies and WCR plans
sections.summary: Asks what studies supported the $4.7 million SecureMyBike project at Admiralty MRT, discontinued for lack of demand, and how future walk, cycle and ride infrastructure will be ensured.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what are the studies, projections or cost-benefit analyses that supported development of the $4.7 million SecureMyBike project at Admiralty MRT that has been discontinued due to lack of demand; and (b) how does the Ministry plan to ensure future walk, cycle and ride (WCR) infrastructure improvements.

sections.label: LTA ends bicycle parking pilot
sections.summary: LTA ended the pilot because fees could not cover operating cost; Kampung Admiralty succeeded overall but underground bicycle parking was disappointing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: As the fees collected could not cover the operating cost, LTA decided to end the pilot or the trial.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: But overall, Kampung Admiralty has been a highly successful project, although the outcome for underground parking for bicycles has turned out to be disappointing.

sections.label: Possible future underground bicycle parking
sections.summary: As PMD numbers fall, shared and private bicycle use may rise, so similar underground bicycle parking systems may be needed in Singapore, perhaps at Kampung Admiralty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: As the number of PMDs comes down, the usage of shared bikes and privately owned bicycles may well rise again.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: I would not be surprised that similar underground bicycle parking systems may be needed in Singapore, perhaps even at Kampung Admiralty, in the future.

sections.label: Planning assumptions and project review
sections.summary: Planning assumptions must be set down clearly to check after project completion, which is why there is always a project review or post-mortem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Indeed, we must have that discipline of making sure that you set down clearly what are the planning assumptions so that you can check back after the project is completed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That is why there is always a project review or a post-mortem so that we learn from it.
